name: Bezier Tetrahedra Evaluation
definition: A set of polynomial solids in the Bernstein basis defined by a bounding tetrahedron T and a set of 20 weights. The cubic BT (order 3) is defined by points T = (T1, T2, T3, T4) and weights {w_ijkl : i+j+k+l=3}.
summary: Bezier Tetrahedra Evaluation computes scalar fields on unstructured grids using cubic Bernstein polynomials, offering higher-order continuity and efficient ray-tracing compared to linear methods.
